title: CI pipeline templating for stepwise pin + crypto-signed profile promotion
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Model onboarding today is a mix of manual steps and bespoke CI jobs per-model. Engineers sign artifacts by hand, publish performance profiles manually, and then perform an ad-hoc pin/canary rollout. This increases lead time, causes inconsistent provenance records, and makes rollbacks error-prone.

Goal: Deliver a reusable, parameterized CI pipeline template that standardizes model build -> attest/sign -> publish-profile -> stepwise promote(pin) flow. Pipeline should produce cryptographic provenance (cosign/rekor), create version pins in the release broker only after automated canary evaluation passes, and emit audit-friendly logs. The pipeline must be usable for hosted and private onboarding flows and compatible with our model-registry artifacts and performance profile manifest format.

Scope: Implement templated YAML and helper scripts in platform repo, wire into GitHub Actions and our self-hosted runners, integrate Cosign sigstore signing and Rekor transparency log, add a 'canary-eval' step that runs perf tests against a short traffic window, and produce a single CLI command (or Makefile target) to run an end-to-end smoke run locally.
acceptance_criteria: A CI template (templates/onboard-template.yml) exists and can be invoked via a single PR in the platform repo
Artifacts are produced with a deterministic filename and signed with Cosign; signature and Rekor entry are stored in the artifact registry
A performance profile JSON is published to the performance-catalog service under a staging channel
Canary evaluation job runs automated perf tests (p50/p95/latency and token cost checks) and gates promotion based on configurable thresholds
Pinning to prod-release channel only occurs after canary-eval success; pin action is recorded in the release broker with provenance link
Rollback path: a single job can retract a pin and mark profile as retracted with audit message
End-to-end E2E smoke test runs in CI and is green in the platform repo PR
Documentation (Confluence + README in repo) covers KMS setup, runner permissions, and how to run locally
success_metrics: Reduce manual onboarding steps from median 6 -> <=2
Decrease median time from PR merge to pinned profile from 2 days -> <2 hours (for standard small models)
Zero unsigned artifacts merging to release channel (enforced by CI), target = 100%
Number of onboarding incidents traced to missing provenance = 0 over next quarter

decisions: Use Cosign (sigstore) for artifact signing and Rekor for transparency logs to avoid building a custom attestation service
Pipeline template will be GitHub Actions-first but written so runners and job steps can be ported to Jenkins/Argo in the future
Canary gating thresholds will be configurable in the model's onboarding manifest; default thresholds set conservatively to avoid false positives
tradeoffs_and_risks: Integrating KMS for signing increases security but requires cross-team work with infra (KMS credentials on runners) — blocks until infra ticket is approved
Tight gating reduces risk of regressions but will increase time to pin for noisy models; we allow overrides for critical releases
Relying on Cosign/Rekor adds third-party dependency; we mitigate with monitoring of Rekor availability and a fallback manual attestation flow
implementation_notes: CI jobs: ci/onboard-build, ci/attest-sign, ci/publish-profile, ci/canary-eval, ci/promote-pin, ci/rollback-pin
Runner permissions: self-hosted runners need read/write to artifact-registry and access to KMS key 'projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/models/keys/onboard-signing'
Profile format: performance profile must include 'p50', 'p95', 'cost_per_token_usd', 'dataset_id' and a high-level evaluation hash
risks: KMS credential provisioning delay (blocked by infra ticket)
Canary noise causes repeated failures for high-variance models
Edge-case models with nonstandard artifact packaging will require adapter steps
rollout_plan: Pilot with 2 low-risk models (search-reranker-v1, summarizer-small) during 2025-W07
Collect canary metrics and adjust default thresholds after 1 week
Onboard internal platform teams and publish a migration guide
Graduate template to 'platform-supported' and add to onboarding checklist
testing_plan: Integration tests that run build+sign against a mock Rekor in CI
End-to-end smoke in a real test environment with synthetic traffic for canary
Chaos test: simulate Rekor downtime and validate fallback attestation path
